text:
Maya Chen: FYI — Lumina Inc (midmarket) just hit our 60% usage drop rule. Trial ends in 18 days. Thinking we try a 'soft exit + comeback' play instead of hard save. Short plan below.

Leo Patel: ok — quick context? last touch? health score?

Maya Chen: last touch was 3 weeks ago, onboarding session happened but they didn't complete the CSV import. Health score fell from 78 -> 42. Billing not yet set.

Ada Flores: 42 is risky, but they're not churned. I like soft exit idea. What's that look like in concrete steps?

Maya Chen: high level: 1) Gentle downgrade road: offer to pause paid features and keep data for 30 days; 2) Micro enablement: 30-min lab focused on CSV import + 2 quick wins; 3) Time-limited credit: 1 week of free tokens to try quantized pipeline; 4) Feedback capture: 3-question in-session poll + short CX survey; 5) Re-engage trigger: if they use import + run <2> jobs => schedule AM check-in.

Samir Khan: can we automate the downgrade road in the portal? we don't want billing chaos.

Ada Flores: yes — product already supports "pause" state. ops just needs the flag set + email template.

Maya Chen: draft email snippet: 
```
Hi {{first_name}},
We noticed low activity and want to make this easier — we can pause your paid plan for 30 days and keep your data intact. If you want to stay live, we'll also reserve a complimentary 30-min lab to finish imports. No action needed to pause — reply to this email and we'll take care of it.
```

Leo Patel: love the low-friction messaging. Add an explicit CTA to book the lab via Calendly link. Also include a small tutorial GIF.

onboarding-bot: Reminder: Calendly booking link for Lumina Inc not set (action required by Ada Flores).

Ada Flores: putting Calendly and GIF in place today. Will attach the 2-question poll in session notes so we can capture reasons for inactivity.

Samir Khan: for the time-limited credit, what's the exact offer? avoids overdiscounting.

Maya Chen: proposal: give 2500 token credit + 1-week priority support. That's a small cost but high signal.

Leo Patel: agreed. Also add a follow-up cadence: 3 days post-lab check-in (auto), 10 days reminder if paused, and 25-day pre-data-retention-expiry alert to CSM.

Ada Flores: will update playbook doc and create two templates: (1) pause email, (2) reactivation flow. I'll also tag Billing for the pause flag play.

Maya Chen: tagging @Samir for support on tracking outcome events: `import_completed`, `first_generated_text`, `billing_paused`. We need these for reporting.

Samir Khan: got it — I'll add those events to the Lumina customer stream and surface them in the CS dashboard.

Leo Patel: final checklist before we run on Lumina: 
- template email ready (Ada)
- Calendly + session content (Ada)
- billing pause flag tested (Billing ops)
- credit provisioning flow (Finance)
- events wired to dashboard (Samir)
- kickoff message to customer (Maya)

Maya Chen: moving to action — I'll DM Billing/Finance and ping Lumina today with the pause offer + bookable lab. Will post updates here. :rocket: 

Ada Flores: thanks team. I'll drop the updated templates into the playbook doc and add a short rubric for when to use soft-exit vs full-save plan.

Maya Chen: note to self — capture NPS-like reason options in the 2-question poll: "blocked by import / pricing / product mismatch / other (free text)" so we can triage root cause quickly.

Leo Patel: perfect. Keep it lean and instrumented.

Maya Chen: update 1762468320 — Lumina replied, booked lab for Wed 10am. We'll run the play and report outcomes back in this thread.
